name: comp-377

frames.best_why: Account menu is fully open with the profile header and Settings row highlighted.

tagline: A small avatar in the header drops a menu of account and team links.
summary: An avatar with a chevron in a site header opens an account menu. The menu shows the user's name and email, then Profile, Billing, Settings, Team, Documentation and Logout.
appearance: A rounded dark header bar holds the word Acme, three grey nav labels and, at the right, a small round photo with a chevron. Clicking it opens a dark menu aligned to the right edge: a bold name over a grey email, then two groups of icon rows and a Logout row, split by thin rules.
behaviour: Clicking the avatar opens the menu; hovering a row highlights it and choosing one closes the menu. Clicking outside or pressing Escape dismisses it.
demo_content: 'Acme' header with Dashboard, Projects, Reports; menu shows Keith Kennedy and Profile, Billing, Settings, Team, Logout.
search_phrases: avatar menu in the page header
account dropdown with profile and logout
user menu with name and email
click your photo to open account options
profile menu with billing and settings
use_when: A signed-in header needs quick access to profile, billing and logout without a sidebar.
avoid_when: The avatar trigger is small and the menu is fixed narrow, so long names or emails get truncated.
customise: The user name, email, avatar URL and every menu label are fixed in the file; the trigger and menu alignment are set in code.
weight_why: A small menu with one avatar image; nothing runs until opened.

a11y.note: The trigger has an aria-label and the menu follows standard menu roles with arrow keys; no reduced-motion handling.

issues: The menu is a fixed 240px wide, so long names and emails are truncated.
Menu items have no actions wired; choosing one only closes the menu.
polish_why: Clean header and tidy menu; it is a conventional account dropdown.
